title: Gauze
description: Twelve fine picks through a loose linen warp.
alt: Thin peach, rose, blue and yellow threads slip one by one through pale linen threads to form a loose open cloth, then slip out.
note: The first version used thick black and white bands and was correct but heavy. Asking for thread instead of bands, and for over/under shown as gaps so no background colour is needed, is what made it light. Review found the palest threads disappearing at small sizes, so they are now slightly heavier.
author: Maria Roszyk
